rules: One row per open NHS trust or care trust in the ODS etr and ect files. CQC: the trust's own overall rating (Service and Domain both 'Overall'), joined on CQC Provider ID = ODS code. Workforce: NHS Workforce Statistics Core 1, organisation rows for the latest month; FTE rounded to one decimal place. RTT: total incomplete pathways and the published waits by provider. A null block means that publisher reports nothing for the code.

fieldMeanings.workforce.<group>.fte / headcount: staff in post, full-time equivalent and headcount
fieldMeanings.rtt.wl: total incomplete RTT pathways (the waiting list)
fieldMeanings.rtt.pct18: % of the waiting list within 18 weeks
